summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Split Margins, Risk Engine, and Pricing Guidelines features in Simple Calculator mode. All backend APIs pass (9/9 tests). Frontend features are fully functional including Pricing Guidelines Panel, Split Margins toggle, Risk Factors inputs, and margin warnings.
passed_tests: ✅ Backend: GET /api/pricing-guidelines returns guidelines by deal size (Tiny, Standard, Big, Mega) and service type (Branding, Campaign, Staffing)
✅ Backend: GET /api/risk-config returns risk configuration with levels and weights
✅ Backend: POST /api/calculate/simple with unified margin (split margins disabled)
✅ Backend: POST /api/calculate/simple with split margins (internal + vendor margins)
✅ Backend: Risk factors affect final selling price (verified price increase with risk)
✅ Backend: Separate internal and vendor risk multipliers calculated correctly
✅ Backend: Margin warnings generated when below minimum guideline
✅ Backend: GET /api/vendor-services returns vendor services
✅ Backend: GET /api/roles returns roles with calculated benefits
✅ Frontend: Pricing Guidelines Panel displays margin guidelines by deal size
✅ Frontend: Pricing Guidelines Panel displays margin guidelines by service type
✅ Frontend: Split Margins toggle shows Internal Margin % and Vendor Margin % inputs when enabled
✅ Frontend: Achieved Margins section shows Internal, Vendor, and Blended margins
✅ Frontend: Internal Team Risk Factors collapsible section appears when team members exist
✅ Frontend: Vendor Risk Factors collapsible section appears when vendors exist
✅ Frontend: Risk factors (complexity, rush, execution) affect final selling price
✅ Frontend: Risk Assessment section in Profitability Dashboard shows risk multiplier and price impact
✅ Frontend: Warning display shows red/amber warnings when margin is below minimum guideline
✅ Frontend: Profitability Dashboard shows Revenue, Net Profit, Contribution Margin, Cost Breakdown
✅ Frontend: Add team member button works (select role, enter hours, see cost preview)
✅ Frontend: Add vendor button works (select service, enter cost, see markup calculation)
seed_data_creation: Pricing guidelines and risk config already seeded via /api/seed-data
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (Split Margins, Risk Engine, Pricing Guidelines Panel) are working correctly. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_pricing_features.py cover all calculation scenarios. Risk factors use weighted multiplier system (complexity: 0.4, rush: 0.35, execution: 0.25). Pricing guidelines show min/target/premium margins for deal sizes (Tiny <50K, Standard 50K-200K, Big 200K-500K, Mega 500K+) and service types (Branding, Campaign, Staffing).

pricing_guidelines_panel.details: Shows margin guidelines by deal size (Tiny, Standard, Big, Mega) and service type (Branding, Campaign, Staffing). Displays current margin status with color-coded badges (Below Min, Acceptable, Target, Premium).

split_margins.details: Toggle enables separate Internal Margin % and Vendor Margin % inputs. Achieved Margins section shows Internal, Vendor, and Blended margins.

risk_factors.details: Internal Team Risk Factors and Vendor Risk Factors collapsible sections appear when respective items exist. Risk factors (complexity, rush, execution) affect final selling price through weighted multiplier system.

margin_warnings.details: Red/amber warnings displayed when margin is below minimum guideline. Warning message shows current margin and minimum threshold.

profitability_dashboard.details: Shows Revenue, Net Profit, Contribution Margin, Cost Breakdown (Internal Labor, Vendor Cost, Overhead, Total COGS), Revenue Breakdown, Deductions, and Risk Summary.
